title: Lipschitz push-forward and affine homotopy operators on compactly supported IM currents: linearity, locality, mass bounds 2.27, supports, ∂-commutation and the homotopy formula 2.25, integrality
statement: Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω)); X − Y is the contract subtraction (pointwise on test forms). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of max(X(ω), 0) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, where |·| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors (covectorEuclideanNorm); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U is the contract structure IMRep U d; R represents X when X(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHᵈ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U), where ⟨ω, ξ⟩(x) = ξ(x)(ω(x)); μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M is R.measure and R.action(β) = ∫_M θ ξ(β) dHᵈ for any d-form β; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep represents it. X vanishes off a set E if X(ω) = 0 for every ω whose tsupport is disjoint from E. Assume (IMS) the exact frozen statement of dor_lmb_fc_im_series (a resolved dependency of the parent node, not yet accepted, hence taken as an antecedent): for all P, m, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and IM currents X_r ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) (r ∈ ℕ) with Σ_r M(X_r) ≠ ∞ there is an IM Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) with Σ_r X_r(ω) = Y(ω) (HasSum) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(U) and M(Y) ≤ Σ_r M(X_r). For every P ∈ ℕ there are operations push_k(F, X) ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) and homot_k(F, G, X) ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) (k ∈ ℕ, F, G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), domain univ) such that, for every k, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ-Lipschitz F, G, F', G', compact E ⊆ ℝ^P and IM X, Y ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) vanishing off E: (1) push_k(id, X) = X; (2) push_k(F, X − Y) = push_k(F, X) − push_k(F, Y) and homot_k(F, G, X − Y) = homot_k(F, G, X) − homot_k(F, G, Y); (3) if F = F' and G = G' on E then push_k(F, X) = push_k(F', X) and homot_k(F, G, X) = homot_k(F', G', X); (4) push_k(F, X) and homot_k(F, G, X) are IM, M(push_k(F, X)) ≤ Λ^k·M(X), push_k(F, X) vanishes off F(E), homot_k(F, G, X) vanishes off {F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)) : x ∈ E, t ∈ [0, 1]}, and for every δ ∈ ℝ with |F(x) − G(x)| ≤ δ for all x ∈ E, M(homot_k(F, G, X)) ≤ δ(2Λ)^k·M(X) (δ via ENNReal.ofReal); (5) if X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) is IM, vanishes off E and ∂X is IM, then ∂push_{k+1}(F, X) = push_k(F, ∂X) and push_{k+1}(G, X) − push_{k+1}(F, X) − homot_k(F, G, ∂X) = ∂homot_{k+1}(F, G, X). (push_k(F, X) = F_#X and homot_k(F, G, X) = h_#([[(0,1)]] × X) for the affine homotopy h(t, x) = F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)): Simon 2.17–2.29 with 3.2(2), 3.9.)
